messages:
henry: Heads up  we need a compact, enforceable rule for SI co-sell when marketplace SKUs, HW bundles, or POCs with costs are involved. Two deals slipped because demo ownership wasn't clear.

marta: Agreed. can we make a three-factor owner decision: certified_hw || marketplace_optin || poc_costs_paid_by_si => SI owns; else AE. Want something dev-friendly so intake validation can fail fast.

saanvi: +1. add an acknowledgement SLA: partner must accept ownership in the intake flow within 24h, otherwise it falls back to AE. Also record the partner registration_ts for tie-breakers.

tyler: On POC costs: if SI covers >= 50% of POC costs OR finances a local lab environment, SI gets ownership and PS lead. We need a rebate_owner flag for accounting, too.

finance-bot: Reminder: rebate_owner (Partner/Redwood/Shared) must be set before contract is moved to legal for accurate forecasting.

henry: Practical snippet for intake (pasteable):

```
# owner resolution
if certified_hw == True or marketplace_optin == True or poc_cost_share >= 0.5:
  owner = 'SI'
elif ARR >= 250000:
  owner = 'SI'
else:
  owner = 'AE'
# tie-breaker
if multi_si == True:
  owner = earliest_partner_registration()
```

marta: Also add a field: 'demo_owner' separate from 'contract_owner'. Demo_owner defaults to whoever provides the demo environment or first demo presenter. That avoids last-minute swaps.

saanvi: Good call. add 'demo_record_required' boolean too. If demo_record_required == True -> require marketing + legal notice before public materials.

tyler: Edge-case: territory carveouts. If opportunity account is carved to a field rep owned by SI (per territory map), partner gets priority independent of SKU. We'll need a territory_id field in intake.

henry: Decision: include territory check as an early condition. If territory_assigned_to_SI == True -> SI owns unless AE escalation approved. Add to snippet.

marta: Workflow asks: AE must fill intake within 24h of first SI contact or stage change. Missing intake auto-tags #partners-triage and opens PART-4901.

partners-bot: Note: You can configure auto-post via /workflows. See docs at https://rwd.atlassian.net/space/PS/automations :robot_face:

finance-bot: Also capture 'rebate_estimate_usd' numeric so Finance can model. Mark that as optional pre-contract but required before legal kickoff.

henry: Action items: 1) Marta: add decision table + demo_owner field to intake by EOD Tue. 2) Saanvi: implement 24h partner ack + registration_ts logic; add demo_record_required flag. 3) Tyler: export territory map and add territory_id matching to intake. 4) Finance: ensure rebate_owner enum and rebate_estimate_usd validation.

marta: I'll open a small PR and include example CSV for Commerce SKUs (incl 'rdw-marketplace-pro', 'rdw-edge-bundle-v2') and sample territory mappings.

saanvi: I'll add a tiny Slack workflow: when intake marks poc_cost_share >= 0.5 or certified_hw true -> post to #partners-triage with opp link and owner suggestion.

tyler: For demos: require recording and a short slide (1-pager) capturing what the SI did vs Redwood. That helps later attribution and marketing.

henry: Last question: co-announcement window? SI asked 8 business days (leaner than marketing asks). Can we standardize to 10bd but accept 8bd if all assets pre-approved in advance?

marta: Let's make default 10bd and allow expedited 8bd with explicit marketing + legal signoff checkbox in intake. Capture "announce_expedite_approved" boolean.

partners-bot: Created task PART-4901 "SI intake: demo_owner + rebate fields + territory match" assigned to marta, saanvi, tyler, due in 4 days. https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/PART-4901

henry: Recap in one line for the doc: Marta (intake + PR), Saanvi (ack + workflow), Tyler (territory + demo slides), Finance (rebate fields).

marta: no objections. shipping conservative defaults then iterate via telemetry.

henry: thanks all 64f. should cut down last-minute chaos.
